prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production quality Unity VFX texture atlas, a single transparent RGBA image. Two equal vertical cells side by side: LEFT a warm orange throttle exhaust flame, RIGHT a blue/cyan nitro exhaust flame. Each flame points straight UP, with the wide circular nozzle opening at the BOTTOM and tapering to a narrow tip at the TOP. Root positions horizontally at 25% and 75% of the full canvas, height 92% down; tips at 8% down. Each flame stays strictly inside its half; no overlap. No nozzle, vehicle, hardware, scene, shadow, floor, captions, letters, cell border, or checkerboard. Actual transparent background and softly translucent flame edges. Both flames occupy the SAME height and same maximum width inside their cells, suitable to be scaled by the engine to existing approved sizes. Many fine internal wisps and tongues, smooth high quality gradient with luminous pale central core and colored translucent exterior, no solid geometric cones, no comic outline, no large uniform white patches, no smoke clouds, no huge bloom. Carefully rendered detail, clean photographic VFX asset. Visual direction 1: natural turbulent combustion. Sculpted interweaving layered wisps, delicate curling edges, visible warm yellow/orange/red interior striations on the left; translucent royal blue and ice blue wisps with restrained white center on the right. Rich believable irregular structure, softer feathered tips. Beautiful premium arcade VFX.
